# Any scope: profile slots and rules per profile ([location_profiles]).
pp_lprof_slots = { value = 12 }
pp_lprof_rule_count = { value = 5 }

# Country scope: 1 while a location of the country has a profile (the profile rule group runs and takes an equal
# share of the monthly limit, pp_cplan_groups_on).
pp_lprof_group_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { pp_lprof_has_locations = yes }
		value = 1
	}
}

# Location scope, in the pass (scope:pp_cplan_btype and the cost values set): the payback of its next level + 100,
# compared with the rule's limit (+ 100); 1 + the build cost, the start picker's key (never 0, which is unset).
pp_lprof_payback100 = {
	value = pp_cplan_est_payback_years
	add = 100
}
pp_lprof_cost1 = {
	value = pp_cplan_est_cost
	add = 1
}

# Location scope: the profile slot (0 none).
pp_lprof_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof }
		value = var:pp_lprof
		subtract = 100
	}
}
